caption: Spicy amber-orange broth with visible noodles and minced meat, a red spice ball floating on top, sits in a black ceramic bowl with a glossy, rounded rim. Toppings include a halved boiled egg, dark green nori with visible veins, and tender pale pink chashu pork with fat marbling, all on a warm brown wooden table.

segments_info.text: Wooden table surface shows warm brown tones, smooth grain patterns, and subtle light reflections.
Chashu pork slice shows tender, pale pink meat with visible fat marbling and slightly uneven surface.
The nori seaweed is dark green, textured, irregularly shaped, and has a slightly rough surface with visible veins.
The spicy broth is amber-orange, glossy, and contains visible noodles and minced meat, with a red spice ball floating on top.
A halved boiled egg shows a firm, pale yellow yolk surrounded by smooth, white albumen with a slightly glossy surface.
Black ceramic ramen bowl with smooth, glossy surface and slightly raised, rounded rim.
A red spoon with smooth, glossy surface and slightly curved bowl shape.
